title: Holomorphic mappings of finitely connected planar domains
summary: Results on holomorphic mappings of finitely connected planar domains are often proved using Koebe's famous circle mapping theorem. A prominent example is Julia's bound on the size of the automorphism group of finitely connected planar domains of connectivity $k\geq3$ and the sharp bound obtained later by Heins. The purpose of this article is to explore whether it is possible to give a proof of these results, and several other related results, without using Koebe's theorem.
